segments.text:
WHyle Ieſus ſpake vnto the people, beholde, there came a certayne ruler, and worſhipped hym, ſaying: my doughter is euē nowe diſceaſed, but come and laye thy hande vpon her, and ſhe ſhall liue. And Ieſus aroſe & folowed hym, and ſo dyd his diſcyples. And beholde, a woman which was diſeaſed with an iſſue of bloude twelue yeres, came behinde him and touched the hemme of his beſture. For ſhe ſayd within her ſelfe: If I maye touche but euen his veſture only, I ſhalbe ſafe. But Ieſus turned hym about, and when he ſawe her, he ſayde: doughter be of good cōfort, thy fayth hath made thee ſafe. And the woman was made whole euen that ſame tyme. And whē Ieſus came into the rulers houſe, and ſawe the minſtrelles and the people makyng a noyſe, he ſayde vnto them: get you hence, for the mayde is not dead but ſlepeth.
And they laughed hym to ſcorne: But when the people were put furth, he went in, and toke her by the hande, and ſayd: damoſell ariſe. And the damoſel aroſe. And this noiſe went abrode into all that lande.
